# Sahibul NF

> Portfolio of Sahibul Nuzul Firdaus — full-stack Flutter engineer building production mobile apps, Golang APIs, and cloud-backed systems from Aceh, Indonesia. Open for freelance and remote roles.

Sahibul ships multi-platform Flutter products with Supabase, Firebase, and AWS backends. Selected work includes a 102K+ LOC workflow canvas (client), Nourdaily (Muslim content platform), Cardx (collectibles), and hiQuran (65+ GitHub stars).

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://sahibul.dev/): Hero, selected work, experience, about, contact, and resume modal.
- [Selected work](https://sahibul.dev/#work): Featured projects with stack tags and links.
- [Case studies](https://sahibul.dev/#cases): Problem / approach / result write-ups for BonkBytes canvas and Cardx.
- [Experience](https://sahibul.dev/#experience): Work history from BonkBytes, Musopen, S2bc Studios, DrugLift, and earlier roles.
- [About & skills](https://sahibul.dev/#about): Core stack, skills groups, and background.
- [Contact](https://sahibul.dev/#contact): Email, social links, and Netlify contact form.
- [Resume / CV](https://sahibul.dev/#resume): Interactive resume with one-page and extended variants; printable PDF.

## Projects

- [Nourdaily](https://nourdaily.com): Flutter Muslim community content platform (articles, video, audio, discussions).
- [PukatFlow](https://pukatflow.netlify.app): Android trip ledger for boat operators with AI-assisted entries.
- [hiQuran on GitHub](https://github.com/sahibul-nf/hiQuran): Flutter Quran app — 65+ stars, Supabase and Firebase.
- [solo-dev-ai-kit](https://github.com/sahibul-nf/solo-dev-ai-kit): Portable AI-assisted solo-dev workflow bootstrap.
- [Quotes App](https://github.com/sahibul-nf/quotes_app): Flutter quotes app with Supabase backend.
